segments.en: Today I practise computer English in a real conversation. I need to explain a small task clearly to another person. I say "encryption" when I talk about my computer project. I say "encrypted connection" when I talk about my computer project. I say "privacy setting" when I talk about my computer project. I tell my teammate: Today I use encryption, encrypted connection, and privacy setting. At the end, I say: I can use encryption clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“计算机英语”，场景是“加密、隐私与备份”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。encryption：加密，把数据转换成未经授权无法读取的形式。示例：I learned how to use "encryption" in a computer task.encrypted connection：加密连接，传输内容受到保护的网络连接。示例：I learned how to use "encrypted connection" in a computer task.privacy setting：隐私设置，控制个人信息如何被使用和展示。示例：I learned how to use "privacy setting" in a computer task.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“受保护分支”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。protected branch：受保护分支，限制直接修改的重要分支。示例：Our team uses "protected branch" to keep the project clear.branch protection rule：分支保护规则，规定合并前必须满足的条件。示例：Our team uses "branch protection rule" to keep the project clear.required approval：必需批准，合并前必须获得的评审同意。示例：Our team uses "required approval" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。
